Package org.tasktide.engine.policies

Class AbstractAcquisitionPolicy<T extends TaskTideModel<T>>

java.lang.Object
org.tasktide.engine.policies.AbstractAcquisitionPolicy<T>
Type Parameters:
T - of TaskTideModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
TaskTideWorkloadAcquisitionPolicy<T>
Direct Known Subclasses:
WorkItemAcquisitionPolicy
public abstract class AbstractAcquisitionPolicy<T extends TaskTideModel<T>> extends Object implements TaskTideWorkloadAcquisitionPolicy<T>
Abstract implementation of TaskTideWorkloadAcquisitionPolicy to take the field policy building, and field getter aspects. Preserves generic TaskTideModel type to allow implementing class to focus on the specifics of building/fetching the required TaskTideModel collection
